ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a simple, benign explanatory task with no harm-adjacent or hostile elements, so neither model's aversions apply. The deciding factor was capability — Curlew posts higher scores across every relevant benchmark (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4) and internal eval (Creative Generation 85.9 vs 78.8, Summarization 83.7 vs 80.3). Since cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, there was no reason not to pick the stronger model, which also happens to favor exactly this kind of open-ended generative work.
